definitions: Provided or served as clear evidence of something's existence or truth.
Declared to be true or accurate.
Confirmed the authenticity of something by one's signature or oath.
examples: The document was attested by two witnesses.
His bravery was attested by his comrades.
The will was attested by a notary public.
pastTenses: attested (simple past), attested (present perfect), attested (past perfect)
